info.title: Sedis PartnerAPI v2
info.description:
The Sedis PartnerAPI v2 is a REST + JSON API for programmatic access to Sedis Fastighetsbenchmark and Bolagsanalys data.

Authenticate with the `X-Api-Key` header (issued per customer). Responses are camelCase and paged with the bare `{data, page, pageSize, totalCount, totalPages}` envelope.

A CompDatum value carries EXACTLY ONE of `figure` (decimal) or `date` (ISO `yyyy-MM-dd`): parameters whose code starts with 'D' are date-typed and populate `date` (with `figure` null); all others populate `figure` (with `date` null). The `lastUpdatedUtc` field is a full UTC instant.

The code-defined CompDatum enum domains are published as typed integer-enum component schemas (CompClassification = EA0, CompTransactionKind = EC0, CompTransactionType = ED0, CompEpcEnvironmentalRating = EE0, CompValuationMethod = EF0, CompValuationAgency = EG0, CompSustainabilityCertification = EH0); a CompDatum enum value's `enum.value` is the integer they enumerate. EB0 (PropertyType) is the exception: it is DATA-DRIVEN (a database table, not a compile-time enum) and therefore has no static schema — discover its live domain at runtime via `/v2/fastighetsbenchmark/parameters/EB0` (`enumValues`).

get.summary:
Returns a camelCase status payload whose `message` is localized by the resolved request
culture: English by default, Swedish when the caller sends `?lang=sv` or
`Accept-Language: sv` (LOC-03b). Proves the `/v2` localization branch defaults to
English without touching the GUI sv-SE pipeline.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Response language for localized text (parameter names/descriptions, status messages). Accepts 'en' (default) or 'sv'. Equivalent to the Accept-Language header; the query parameter wins when both are sent.

parameters.name: Accept-Language
parameters.description: Preferred response language for localized text (en or sv). The ?lang= query parameter takes precedence when both are sent.

get.summary: Lists CompDatum time-series rows for the calling tenant.
get.description: Returns the v2 comp-data list (camelCase, bare envelope), tenant-scoped via the parent Comp join. Each row is self-describing via dataType (decimal|boolean|enum|date — from the parameterCode's first letter): decimal populates figure; boolean populates boolean (+ raw figure); enum populates enum {value,name,enumType} (+ raw figure), its full domain discoverable via /parameters/{code}; date populates date (ISO yyyy-MM-dd). valueDate is the period the value applies to (the natural-key part), distinct from the date-typed value itself. Supports paging, whitelisted sort, sparse fieldsets, ?count=false (bulk-sync count opt-out, D-12), and the named filters sedisId, sedisIdIn, parameterCode, fromDate, toDate.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page number (default 1). Combine with pageSize to walk a result set.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of rows per page (default 50, clamped to a maximum of 500; when clamped the response carries the Sedis-Page-Size-Clamped: true header).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Comma-separated whitelisted sort fields; prefix a field with '-' for descending (e.g. sort=name,-valueDate). Only the fields a given resource exposes are accepted — an unknown field returns 400 with extensions.invalidFields.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated sparse fieldset: limits the response to the named fields and opts IN to optional fields (e.g. fields=sedisId,name,geometry). An unknown field returns 400 with extensions.invalidFields.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: When false, the bulk-sync count opt-out (D-12): totalCount and totalPages are returned null to skip the count query. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: sedisId
parameters.description: Exact-match filter on the resource's SedisId (the string natural key).

parameters.name: sedisIdIn
parameters.description: COMMA-SEPARATED list of SedisIds to match (e.g. sedisIdIn=PU-1,PU-2,PU-3). This is a single comma-delimited string value, NOT a repeated parameter or JSON array. Rows whose SedisId is in the set are returned.

parameters.name: parameterCode
parameters.description: Exact-match filter on the parameter code (e.g. the CompParameterCode discovered via the parameters resource). A 'D'-prefixed code is date-typed (populates date; figure null).

parameters.name: fromDate
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound (ISO yyyy-MM-dd) on valueDate.

parameters.name: toDate
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound (ISO yyyy-MM-dd) on valueDate.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Response language for localized text (parameter names/descriptions, status messages). Accepts 'en' (default) or 'sv'. Equivalent to the Accept-Language header; the query parameter wins when both are sent.

parameters.name: Accept-Language
parameters.description: Preferred response language for localized text (en or sv). The ?lang= query parameter takes precedence when both are sent.

400.description: Bad Request RFC 7807 ProblemDetails. extensions.invalidFields lists the rejected query parameter name(s); extensions.traceId carries the W3C/Application Insights correlation id.

429.description: Too Many Requests RFC 7807 ProblemDetails. extensions.rateLimitRemaining is 0 and extensions.retryAfterSeconds mirrors the Retry-After header (the seconds to wait before retrying).

post.summary: Ingests customer data into the CompUpload pipeline for the calling tenant.
post.description: Stages a CompUpload (one ValueDate) owned by the calling API key's tenant (the owner is NEVER read from the body). Requires a mandatory Idempotency-Key header; replaying the same key returns the original response without staging a duplicate. Returns 201 with the staged upload id + status; 409 when a non-Uploaded upload already exists for the same ValueDate; 400 (RFC 7807, extensions.invalidFields) on validation errors.

post.summary:
Creates a customer-owned Samling (D-35, API-13). The owning tenant is stamped from the API key's
IPartnerApiTenantContext — NEVER the request body (T-62-08-01). Triggers the existing
recalc cascade (create-path BJ0=1 gate + `CalculationRequestQueue` enqueue). Requires a
mandatory `Idempotency-Key` header (replay-safe via IdempotencyKeyFilter).
post.description: Creates a Samling owned by the calling API key's tenant (the owner is NEVER read from the body). Requires a mandatory Idempotency-Key header; replaying the same key returns the original response without creating a duplicate.
